class.name: NNBTSequence
class.brief_description: Executes its child nodes from top-to-bottom order until either all of them succeed (returning [code]1[/code]) or one of them fails (returning [code]-1[/code]).
class.description: This node type is used to create sequences. The [NNBTSequence] node executes its child nodes from top-to-bottom order until either all of them succeed (returning [code]1[/code]) or one of them fails (returning [code]-1[/code]). If a child returns running (0) the sequence will return running to its parent. By default the sequence resumes from the child that was running on the previous tick. When [member reactive] is [code]true[/code] the sequence instead starts evaluating at child 0 on every tick. In both modes disabled children are skipped and a child that returns [code]SKIP[/code] is treated like a child that succeeded (the sequence continues).

members.member: When [code]true[/code], every tick starts evaluating at child 0 instead of resuming from the previously running child. Disabled children are skipped and [code]SKIP[/code] is treated like a success (the sequence continues).
